title: S.T.A.R vs C.A.R interview method - Best interview method/technique
description:
When preparing for interviews you've probably come across these 2 different interview techniques, STAR (S.T.A.R.) & CAR (C.A.R). These are acronyms explaining how you should structure your answer in an interview. 

I made this video because a lot of websites and "coaches" tell you they're the same and you can use either one. WRONG! The STAR (S.T.A.R) method/technique is way better and I've tested it with seasoned interviewers. Watch this video to learn why the STAR interview method is the best for answering behavioral/situational interview questions. 

Explaining STAR & CAR: 01:07
Why STAR is better: 02:15
